name: Homemade Toaster-Oven Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips
whyItWorks: Soft white pita bread sliced into triangles, brushed with light coconut oil or melted butter, dusted with cinnamon and sugar, and baked until crisp. Low in residue, seedless, and comforting.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake pita triangles at 375°F in a toaster oven for 6–8 minutes until crisp and golden.
